thread:
maria: Heads-up — customer acme-inc opened a P1. SSO stopped working after our IdP cert rotation last night. They get an AudienceRestriction failure when the SP posts to our ACS. Error snippet from their logs: "AudienceRestriction failed for assertion". They say signature verifies ok though.

alex: looking at our ACS logs for their tenant, assertion arrives and we reject it with audience mismatch. IdP assertion contains AudienceURI 'https://internal-proxy.acme' while our SP expects 'https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/acme-inc'.

kim: (acme) Confirmed. We rotated certs yesterday and also deployed a proxy change that rewrites Host to an internal hostname for routing. We think the proxy is unintentionally changing the entityID/Audience in the authnrequest flow.

jordan: Can you paste a sanitized SAML assertion + the IdP metadata so we can confirm the audience and ACS entries? Also which SP entityID are we advertising to them?

maria: paste below (sanitized):
```xml
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AudienceRestriction>
      <saml:Audience>https://internal-proxy.acme</saml:Audience>
    </saml:AudienceRestriction>
  </saml:Conditions>
  <ds:Signature>...valid...</ds:Signature>
</saml:Assertion>
```
IdP metadata excerpt:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme">
  <SingleSignOnService Binding="..." Location="https://idp.acme/sso"/>
  <KeyDescriptor use="signing">...new-cert-thumbprint...</KeyDescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Our SP entityID on file: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata/acme-inc
Our ACS configured: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/acme-inc (no alt host listed).

saml-bot: Note: cert rotation (rotation-id: rot-20260318-02) completed 2026-03-18T02:12:14Z. No errors reported in rotation job.

alex: hypothesis: the proxy rewrite causes the AuthnRequest's AssertionConsumerServiceURL or the RelayState flow to contain the internal host; IdP then constructs the Audience from the request or from SSO binding context and issues assertion scoped to the internal host. When ACS receives it, audience doesn't match our configured SP endpoints -> reject.

kim: Customer can reproduce by curling our SSO entry through their proxy: `curl -H "Host: internal-proxy.acme" https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/acme-inc --data @samlresponse.xml` they see the same audit failure.

maria: Temporary workarounds we discussed: 1) Acme to add internal-proxy.acme as an allowed Audience in their IdP metadata for our SP (add alternate ACS endpoint), OR 2) We update our SP config for that tenant to accept both the canonical ACS and the internal host as valid audiences. Both are temporary.

jordan: Long-term fix: our SP should canonicalize the incoming request host when behind a trusted proxy (read X-Forwarded-Host/X-Forwarded-Proto) rather than letting the proxy rewrite leak into SAML endpoint URLs. Add config flag `trust_proxy_headers = true` scoped to tenant or deployment and only allow from known CIDR ranges.

alex: I'll open an engineering issue and propose a small canary patch: detect X-Forwarded-Host, use it only when request originates from internal network or when a tenant has an allowlist. Plan: canary in staging, then progressive rollout to 3% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on SAML failures. Ticket INF-2345 opened: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2345

maria: Created support ticket SUP-7892 and asked Acme to temporarily add the alternate ACS in their IdP to unblock login. I'll coordinate timing for the canary window.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued for branch `saml/proxy-trust` to staging — job id deploy-9981.

alex: quick config snippet I'll add to SP code (pseudo):
```python
if request.remote_ip in TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS and headers.get('X-Forwarded-Host'):
    effective_host = headers['X-Forwarded-Host']
else:
    effective_host = headers['Host']
# use effective_host to build expected audience/ACS URL
```

maria: Thanks. Customer asked for ETA — can we get staging canary today and a production patch tomorrow morning?

alex: can do staging today, prod depends on validation but aiming for +24h. I'll post rollout notes and a quick rollback command.

kim: thx team — keep me posted. Ping me when SUP-7892 shows successful login after canary. :eyes:
